Cookie Policy

Updated 14 October 2026

Review draft. The postal contact address, correspondence retention rules and hosting contractual details need confirmation before final publication.

1. About this policy

This policy describes cookies and local storage identified for calmsilver.com, the CalmSilver brand operated by Andre Richard-Peter, Romania. Contact: hello@calmsilver.com. The relevant framework includes GDPR, Directive 2002/58/EC and Romanian Law No. 506/2004.

Browsers send cookies to servers according to their rules. localStorage keeps data in the browser without automatically sending it with each request. Both may fall under device access rules. The CalmSilver panel asks permission only for optional language storage; there are no fictitious analytics or marketing categories.

2. Identified inventory

The inventory separates CalmSilver code from the cookie observed in the infrastructure response. Checked on 14 October 2026. This is not an audit of every internal provider system.

On a narrow screen, you can scroll the table horizontally.

Identified cookies and local storage
Name / type Provider / origin Purpose Category Duration
calmsilver.consent · localStorage CalmSilver · own origin Choice, version and saved / expiry times; no form message. Necessary to respect the choice; not an analytics identifier. 180 days; expiry checked and removed by code, or manual deletion.
calmsilver.language · localStorage CalmSilver · own origin The language ro, en or hu. Optional preference; only after permission. Until withdrawal, deletion or expiry of the 180-day consent; cleanup while the page runs.
__cf_bm · HttpOnly, Secure cookie Cloudflare via hosting · Domain=calmsilver.com in the observed response; Domain=chatgpt.site at the alternative address Protection against automated traffic. Infrastructure security; no optional panel switch. 30 minutes of inactivity according to the provider; observed response expiry was approximately 30 minutes.

3. Choosing and withdrawing permission

Before a choice, we do not remember the language in localStorage. Accept all enables the only optional feature present: remembering the language. Reject optional disables it. Customise offers the same choice through a checkbox that is off by default. Inaction, closing a panel or browsing does not give permission.

Change your choice using the permanent Cookie settings link in the footer. Choose Reject optional, or untick language storage and save, to withdraw. The saved language is removed; the language displayed during the current visit is not forcibly changed. The choice record remains to respect your refusal. The website and form remain usable.

4. Technical limits and your browser

localStorage is separate for each origin. Settings on calmsilver.com and the chatgpt.site address do not automatically synchronise. Each browser or device has its own choices. When consent expires, we check and remove the preference while the page runs; if the page is closed, cleanup occurs at your next visit. You can clear site data earlier in browser settings.

If storage is blocked, the choice applies in memory for the current visit and cannot be remembered for a return visit. The panel cannot delete the HttpOnly __cf_bm cookie or control infrastructure logs. Blocking security cookies in your browser may trigger additional platform checks.

5. No optional tracking in the page code

The page loads no Google Analytics, tag manager, advertising pixels, embedded videos or chatbot. No panel choice activates such services. The form prepares an email locally and does not save its content in cookies or localStorage. Future integrations require an updated inventory and, where required, permission before activation.

The Privacy Policy describes infrastructure technical data, providers, your rights and unconfirmed transfer information.
